title: Amusement park beach
content: This is where I've spent most of my time that I can remember. I'm always near the Ferris wheel and the beach. It feels hazy and almost like things are in black and white and grays and blues. Reminds me of pics of New England, I've never been. I've had these recurring dreams for at least 15 years. I had a very weird prophetic dream by the beach, about my childhood dog. I was throwing a tennis ball into the water, while my childhood dog (border collie mix) was retrieving it every time. The last time I threw it in, she came back out but as a chocolate lab. She told me telepathically her name was maverick now. The next day, I saw on Facebook an acquaintance made a post for chocolate lab puppies that hadn't been born yet. I reserved one (which ended up being the only surviving female from the litter.) she's 6 now. Other notable things I've remembered: Being in a line of women in black hooded robes walking single file by the cabins. If you remember this I SO wanna chat! A "dream" when I was a child (3/4) being picked up by a ufo in my backyard that I only knew as "a carousel with no horses" and taken to many places including mall world. When I was 3+ I started referring to the actual mall as the "Blue Place." Wondering now if I was starting to confuse my dreams with the actual mall. Always begged my mom to take me to the blue place.
